dedupe_keys.name: design and optimization of reliable off grid solar pv battery mini grids for trading centers in uganda

description: Design and Optimization of Reliable Off-Grid Solar PV–Battery Mini-Grids for Trading Centers in Uganda is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset presents a reliability-constrained simulation framework for a solar photovoltaic (PV)–battery mini-grid designed for a representative off-grid trading center in Uganda. The dataset contains hourly load profiles, solar resource data, battery parameters, scenario definitions, state-of-charge (SOC) simulation outputs, reliability assessment results, and model assumptions used in the study. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Correlational Research. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
